title: Laila ka Laal Ran May Tadapta Hai Qaak Par
body:
Laila ka laal ran may tadapta hai qaak par
1. Laila ka laal ran may tadapta hai qaak par
Aawaaz detay jaatay hain Sarwar idhar udhar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Angdayi lekay Akbar e mehroo bhi chal basay
Hichki jo aayi mout ki baba ke haath par
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Thi jab zaeef hatoun pe kadyal jawaan ki laash
Qudd ambiya bhi roopaday manzar ye dekh kar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Uttha na jo Hussain se laasha jawan ka
Khaimo may usko legaye bachay sambhal kar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kya daag maa ko degaye aththara saal may
Laila Fughan ye karti hai sar apna peet kar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Wa akbara ka shoor tha qaimo may chaar soo
Qudd ko giradiya junhii Zainab ne laash par
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Dil may jo tere biyaah ka armaa tha reh gaya
Zainab bayan ye karti thi Akbar ki laash par
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aalam ajab tha syed e sajjad ka sohail
Nok e sina pe dekhar kadyal jawan ka sar
Azz: Raza Ali sohail
